# Error URLs not working in Pydantic

I'm getting errors when trying to access the documentation URLs for Pydantic errors. It seems the error URLs are not properly configured.

## Description

When I try to instantiate a BaseModel directly (which is not allowed), I get an error message with a broken URL:

```python
from pydantic import BaseModel

# This should fail with a helpful error URL
BaseModel()
```

The error message contains a placeholder URL instead of the actual documentation URL:

```
Pydantic models should inherit from BaseModel, BaseModel cannot be instantiated directly

For further information visit <TODO: Set up the errors URLs>/base-model-instantiated
```

The URL should be pointing to the proper error documentation page, but instead it's showing a placeholder text. This makes it difficult to find the proper documentation for fixing the error.

I think the issue is in how the error documentation URLs are constructed. The placeholder text suggests that the error URLs haven't been properly set up.

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and report the resulting local change for handover: pydantic/errors.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
